text.en:
Currency Act
(CHAPTER 69)
Currency
(Denominations and Characteristics of Coins) (No. 3)
Notification 2015
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act, it is notified for general information that the denominations and characteristics of the coins to be issued on 1 January 2016 by the Monetary Authority of Singapore are as shown in the Schedule.

In the centre is the Singapore Coat of Arms with the year-date “2016” below it, and the word “SINGAPORE” in the 4 official languages around the circumference of the coin. A ring of dashes surrounds the Singapore Coat of Arms on both the 10‑cent and 50‑cent coins. The $1 coin has an octagonal frame along the circumference. The $5 coin has a ring of beads surrounding the Singapore Coat of Arms with a latent image below it depicting the year‑date “2016” and the MAS logo.
An image representing the Esplanade ‑ Theatres on the Bay in the centre with the figure “5” on the left of the coin and the word “CENTS” below the image. There is a lion‑head outline on the top left of the coin.
